title: du -J record
description: One line `du` would print, in the same order. Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path.description: The file or directory, as du would print it (`total` for the -c row).

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

size.description: Bytes counted for it and everything below it: disk usage, or the apparent size with --apparent-size / -b. Absent with --inodes.

inodes.description: With --inodes: the number of inodes counted, instead of size.

mtime.description: With --time: the latest mtime in the subtree: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

mtime_ns.description: With --time: the latest mtime in the subtree: nanoseconds since the epoch.

atime.description: With --time=atime: the latest atime in the subtree: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

atime_ns.description: With --time=atime: the latest atime in the subtree: nanoseconds since the epoch.

ctime.description: With --time=ctime: the latest ctime in the subtree: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

ctime_ns.description: With --time=ctime: the latest ctime in the subtree: nanoseconds since the epoch.

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
